preregistration_metadata.title: Phase 16 - Prompt 5 Model A Multi-Seed Confirmation, Pairwise Regularisation, and Model Selection Protocol
constraints: Use ONLY train_minus_dev (and source pool for pairs) and dev_heldout.
Never call load_locked_test or touch locked test set.
All hypothesis tests use 2000-resample bootstrap grouped by commit.

C1.recipe: D2 (UniXcoder fine-tuning with inverse-propensity length debiasing)

C2.recipe: PAIR (Pairwise-regularised fine-tuning with hard vulnerable/fixed pairs)

data_sources.cleaning: Excluded all dev projects, test projects, and MinHash >= 0.8 near-duplicates with dev and test sets

loss_function.margin: softplus ranking penalty driving logit_v > logit_f

C3.recipe: N0 (Frozen CodeBERT CLS+mean + selective cxx28, C=0.01 balanced)
C3.purpose: Negative control verifying frozen model draw and optimization variance

ensemble_rule.method: Unweighted arithmetic average of predicted logits across all seeds in the recipe family
ensemble_rule.formula: p_ensemble = sigmoid(mean([logit_seed_k for k in seeds]))

gate_1.condition: Must beat L1 baseline on length_matched_auroc with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (2000-resample cluster bootstrap by commit on dev_heldout)
gate_1.rationale: Verifies that the model learns genuine vulnerability semantics beyond function length token count.

gate_2.condition: Must not be significantly worse than Faithful Champion P2 (C=0.01) on dev LS-AUROC (p >= 0.05)
gate_2.rationale: Ensures no regression on length-stratified security detection relative to the Phase 15 baseline.

selection_objective.rule: Among all candidates passing Gate 1 and Gate 2, select the candidate that achieves the maximum composite metric.

tie_breaker.rule: If PAIR_ensemble and D2_ensemble composite scores fall within each other's 95% bootstrap confidence interval, select D2_ensemble.
tie_breaker.rationale: Occam's razor: prefer the simpler single-sample debiasing recipe over the pairwise objective when performance is statistically indistinguishable.
